title: WPSS/800/2007 of GEETA CHAND Vs STATE AND ORS.

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 800 (SS) of 2007
Geeta Chand,
W/o Sri B.B. Thakur,
Aged about 29 years,
R / o Village - Chandani,
Banbasa, District - Champawat. ............Petitioner.
Versus
1. State of Uttarakhand through Secretary, Education,
Uttarakhand, Dehradun.
2. Additional Director, State Education Research & Training
Centre, Narendra Nagar, Tehri Garhwal.
3. District Resourse Centre, Lohaghat, Champawat.
............Respondents
Hon'ble M.M. Ghildiyal, J
Heard Sri D.S. Patni and Sri Anil Dabral, learned counsel
for the petitioner and Sri Ashish Joshi, learned Brief Holder for
State of Uttarakhand on behalf of respondents.
Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the
petitioner is taken on record.
Learned counsel for both the parties are agree to decide
the writ petition at its admission stage itself.
By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has prayed
for the following reliefs:
a. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Mandamus
directing the respondents to permit the petitioner to
participate in the counseling which is being held in between
09.07.2007 to 15.07.2007 and allow the petitioner to
undergo Special BTC Training at District Resource Centre
Lohaghat, Champawat.

b. issue any other writ, order or direction which this Hon'ble
court may deem fit and proper in the facts and
circumstances of the case.
c. award the cost of the writ petition to the petitioner.
Candidature of the petitioner was rejected by the
respondents for Special BTC Training course on the ground
that Permanent Resident Certificate issued by SDM, Poornagiri,
Tanakpur, District - Champawat on 08.05.2006 has been
cancelled by him on 12.09.2006.
Petitioner has filed supplementary affidavit wherein she
has stated that the said order dated 12.09.2006 was challenged
by petitioner before this court and this court has been pleased
to allow the writ petition with a direction to SDM, Poornagiri to
pass fresh order relating to Permanent Resident to the
petitioner in accordance with law and order dated 12.09.2006
shall be kept in abeyance till then.
Consequently, I direct the respondents to keep vacant
one seat in Special BTC Training Course, District - Champawat,
till 31.08.2007 and in the meantime, if the petitioner produce
permanent resident certificate issued by SDM, Poornagiri, her
case shall be considered by the respondents for Special BTC
Training Course on merit and if petitioner is in merit, she may
be given admission in Special BTC Training Course.
With this direction, the writ petition as well as interim
relief application stands disposed of. No order as to costs.
(M.M. Ghildiyal, J)
July 09, 2007
SKSharma
